authorMeta.name: rosdapper
text:
Nepali Fusion Series: Episode 1. Is this the ultimate Nepalese momo fusion? 👀 

I’m kicking off my new series with a recipe inspired by one of our most beloved Nepali food: momo. Think of this as a “Momo-Taco” fusion.

If you’ve ever struggled with the art of wrapping momo, don’t worry, I’ve got you. This dish gives you all those traditional flavors of momo without the stress. We’re using a juicy pork filling packed with fresh ginger notes, just like my family makes.

We’re taking traditional Nepalese pork filling. And instead of steaming, we’re pan-searing these for that crispy, golden finish. Then, we coat them in a vibrant achaar made from tomato and toasted sesame also known as “Till” in Nepali. It’s quick, it’s punchy, and it tastes like a classic fried pork momo with achaar 🤤.

You’ve seriously got to try this one. You can find the full recipe over on my Substack! Link is in my bio ❤️‍🔥
